name: Motion kit — fonts, shapes, cursor, 3D
description: Fonts, shapes, cursor, 3D: bundled OFL video fonts, 21 Fontshare families (link-only — download them yourself, then Add fonts), and the Javis.jl ideas (MIT).

items.name: Javis.jl (concepts)
items.description: Julia animation framework. Cupric borrows its ideas, not its code: draw-on paths (Javis `appear(:draw_text)`), actions scheduled in frame ranges on objects, and parent/child object transforms — mapped to shape draw-on, per-clip keyframes and cursor→target linking.

data.attribution: Javis.jl (concepts) — https://github.com/JuliaAnimators/Javis.jl
data.promptCue: Reveal diagrams by drawing strokes on in sequence; schedule each action on a frame range; move children with their parent.

items.name: Montserrat (bold captions)
items.description: Geometric sans at weight 800 is the talking-head caption standard: wide, legible on phones. Bundled.

data.attribution: Montserrat (bold captions) — https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Montserrat
data.promptCue: Captions: Montserrat 800, 6–8% of frame height, white with a soft shadow; emphasise one word.
